summary: Operator's RV page confirms 30-amp full hookups on the creekside lane, back-in gravel/grass sites, a bathhouse and Campspot booking; Campspot's catalog (read 2026-10-13) gives 5 RV sites to 45 ft and Wi-Fi. Fees ($30-55, read 2026-10-13 on Campspot) and season left as recorded; the operator's pages state no season.
flags: Only 5 RV sites, and the operator also advertises 'Seasonal RV sites Available'; nights are for sale on Campspot (5 FHU sites open on 2026-10-20 and 2027-01-26 in the 2026-10-13 read), so it passes the long-stay test, but watch for seasonal takeover of the RV lane.

Peak Saturday rate is $55 plus the park's 3% convenience fee (~$56.65) and Campspot's booking fee; the weekday base ($45 Oct/Jun, $30 Jan) is under US$50. Not stayed at by the family. Nearest-gateway test not run since the base passes.
note: Fishing campground and cabin retreat on 22 wooded acres at Diana, a short drive from Webster Springs, where a creek and a river line two sides of the property.  RV sites #4-10 are on a tree-lined creekside lane, each with a fire ring, and picnic tables are available on request, first come, first served.  Pete's Pond, three acres and stocked, has daily fishing and monthly tournaments, and there are canoes, kayaks, a paddle boat, swimming holes and a hiking trail.  Riverside tent sites, cabins and glamping are also offered, and a small grocery and a diner are down the street.  Pets are allowed for a fee; generators aren't. --Claude
